title: ERL2 V2 blind-selection chain contracts
$comment: Design v2 §15/§16.2, ERL2-FR-024/028/029/030/032/033/034/035/036/037/038/039. The chain is request -> role audit -> ordered pool -> pool checkpoint -> authenticated beacon round -> Lab/verifier association wrapper -> source-trust report -> commitment -> commitment checkpoint -> threshold reveal -> selected binding -> binding checkpoint -> proof -> verification receipt. Each object is closed, so a self-anchoring checkpoint field is structurally impossible.

ExternalBeaconRandomnessPolicyV1.$comment: The one active randomness policy variant. Exactly one source_id; no array, no fallback, no retry.

ThresholdVrfRandomnessPolicyV1.$comment: Reservation marker only. Deliberately NOT a member of SelectionRandomnessPolicyV1. Any admission attempt fails with THRESHOLD_VRF_NOT_ACTIVATED (ERL2-FR-036/039, ERL2-AC-043).

SelectionRandomnessPolicyV1.$comment: Active alias: the external-beacon policy and nothing else.

allOf.$comment: ERL2-AC-028/032: a held-out or blind request may not carry an exact persona, journey or step commitment.
The three non-blind replay fields are all-or-nothing.

SelectorVisibleProfileV1.$comment: ERL2-FR-030/AC-034: one pool-common fixed profile fixes every selector-visible length and metadata value.

HiddenBindingPayloadV1.$comment: Plaintext of the threshold-encrypted per-entry payload. Never appears in a public artifact; only the selected entry is opened.

ExternalBeaconRandomnessReceiptV1.$comment: Owned and signed by the Lab/verifier, not by the beacon (ERL2-FR-038). beacon_signed_payload_hash covers only the canonical beacon round and output.

SelectionRandomnessReceiptV1.$comment: Active alias: the Lab/verifier beacon association wrapper and nothing else.

BeaconSignatureProofV1.$comment: The external beacon's own signature over its canonical round/output, scoped so it can never sign an ERL identifier. Frozen as a PUBLIC artifact and re-parsed by the offline verifier, so it is a closed, schema-governed wire type (review §11.13).

BeaconInclusionProofV1.$comment: The external beacon's chain-inclusion proof for a round. Frozen as a PUBLIC artifact and re-parsed by the offline verifier, so it is a closed, schema-governed wire type (review §11.13).

SelectionCommitmentV2.$comment: Closed: contains no checkpoint field, so it cannot anchor itself (ERL2-FR-033/AC-037).

ThresholdRevealReceiptV1.$comment: core_hash excludes participant_signatures; custodians sign domain ERL2-THRESHOLD-REVEAL-V1.

SelectedChallengeJourneyBindingV1.$comment: Closed: contains no checkpoint field of its own (ERL2-FR-033).

residual_limitation.const: governor/selector/reveal-quorum or privileged-administrator collusion is not excluded
